scope: PCC caps are explicit hypothetical test inputs, not network-derived DOE or grid-code limits.
The cap applies to each 5-minute average PCC active-power value, not every instantaneous measurement.
Use the full known approximately 5-day profile as perfect-foresight offline input, not a deployable forecast or rolling controller.
Minimize total imported electrical energy under a hard cap, storage and plant constraints and equal initial/final SOC. No price or economic cost model.
TES only. No ESS dispatch, IT workload change, DSO power flow, uncertainty, DFL or temperature-dynamic validation.
Energy stress cap follows the frozen baseline minus a specified discharge equivalent for an intentionally infeasible diagnostic; not an independent realistic DSO signal.
